NARRATIVE ZONING ANALYSIS AND PLANS
TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT APPLICATION
1535 North Lawndale Avenue
Type 1 Amendment from RS-3 to B2-1

Blackwood Group LLC, owned by Jose Duarte, has applied for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the
subject property located at 1535 N. Lawndale Avenue to change the zoning classification from the RS-3
Residential Single-Unit District to the B2-1 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

The subject property comprises 6,212.5 square feet and is currently occupied by a one-story commercial
office building, which contains approximately 3,120 square feet. The property is surrounded by RS-3
zoning. To the north is the Maternity Blessed Virgin Mary School, a private institution offering educational
programming from early childhood through eighth grade. The lot to the south of the building is a fenced-
in, vacant lot used as open space, with no outdoor storage, and is part of the subject property. A two-story
residential building is located south of the vacant lot. Lots across the street are single-family homes, and
the lot across the alley features a rear-yard surface parking area for two vehicles in addition to a single-
family home with rear-yard open space.

In 1988, the Zoning Board of Appeals approved resolution 184-88-A, a special use permit that allowed an
auto repair shop to operate on the site. The special use permitted a substitution of a prior nonconforming
commercial use, with conditions prohibiting spray painting, body work, and engine rebuilding. In 2013, the
property was purchased by Blackwood Group, which continued to use the property for office and light
industrial purposes consistent with the historic use.

Blackwood Group will use the building for professional offices related to real estate development and
construction management. The property will not be used as a construction management yard, nor will it be
used for outdoor storage.
